name: Loot tables for blocks, entities and containers
note: Blocks without rules of their own, and wheat, drop from their loot tables (888 of 952 tables in 1.21.8, 880 of 944 in 1.21.4; wall torches, signs, banners and heads by the standing ones' tables), with harvest tools, silk touch and shears; random counts, chances, table bonuses and fortune's ore, uniform and binomial bonuses roll from each table's random sequence, which checkpoints and Anvil worlds keep, as both official servers roll them; other modeled blocks keep fixed drops
deviations: tables that choose between weighted entries drop nothing (no block table has them)
each level keeps its own random sequences; the official servers keep one set for the world
tables that copy components or name dynamic contents (shulker boxes, banners, decorated pots) are not used
modeled blocks ignore their tables, so silk touch does not change their drops
entity, container and archaeology tables are not used
